problem_statement:
This project aims to predict whether an individual

will miss or delay monthly payments such as electricity,

water, rent, car installments, and loans.

Outcome: Late payment risk (0 = On time, 1 = Late).

Decision time: Before monthly payments are due.

Teaching use: Demonstrate how machine learning can

identify potential financial payment risks.

notes.evidence: XGBoost is selected provisionally. Its ROC-AUC and AP should be compared with Logistic Regression and LightGBM using the actual experiment results.
notes.limitation: This experiment uses synthetic data and cannot prove that the model will predict real financial payment behavior accurately.
notes.next_test: Test all three models on new monthly payment data and compare ROC-AUC, AP, and recall before confirming the final model.

exit_answers: AP is important under class imbalance because it measures precision and recall for the minority class, while ROC-AUC may appear high even when positive cases are difficult to identify.
The comparison set must remain separate from early stopping to avoid biased results and ensure a fair evaluation of model performance.
